title: Schedule of Transaction Types and Reward Eligibility, Northgate Credit Cards
content:
This schedule states, for each Northgate Credit Cards product, whether four kinds of transaction earn card rewards: membership fees charged to the card, Northgate Shop Card purchases, cash advances and balance transfers.

## Schedule

| Card product | Membership fees charged to the card earn rewards | Northgate Shop Card purchases earn rewards | Cash advances earn rewards | Balance transfers earn rewards |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Store Card | No | Yes | No | No |
| Northgate Business Store Card | No | Yes | No | No |
| Northgate Rewards Visa Signature | No | Yes | No | No |
| Northgate Rewards Visa Business | No | Yes | No | No |
| Northgate Rewards Visa Signature Plus | No | Yes | No | No |
| Northgate Rewards Visa Business Plus | No | Yes | No | No |

## The schedule in one statement per transaction type

- A membership fee charged to any Northgate card earns no card reward.
- A purchase of a Northgate Shop Card made with any Northgate card earns card rewards.
- A cash advance on any Northgate card earns no card reward.
- A balance transfer to any Northgate card earns no card reward.

## Questions answered from the schedule

**A cardholder pays a Northgate membership fee with a Northgate Rewards Visa Signature Plus. Does the fee earn card rewards?** No. The schedule shows No for membership fees on every card product.

**A business cardholder buys Northgate Shop Cards with a Northgate Business Store Card. Do those purchases earn?** Yes. Northgate Shop Card purchases earn on every card product.

**Does a balance transfer onto a Northgate Rewards Visa Business earn?** No; nor does a cash advance on it.
